notes.title: Stability update and price change
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the game crashing exactly 60 seconds after launching on some systems.
The hidden cheat code menu now has the codes listed.
New 50% lower regular price.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple small bugs:
* Circular mazes should no longer have their central circle entrances blocked by certain traps
* Fixed an issue with enemies not spawning in square mazes in custom maps

notes.title: Multiplayer Morbolbo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36533207/2ea3006bf30daa3e11766cb03c308016da294527.png[/img]

We're proud to announce that there is now up to 4 player online multiplayer in Morbolbo, where you can compete with friends or strangers at who is the fastest at gathering gold and best at avoiding traps.

New multiplayer mode details:
* Compete to gather the most gold within a time limit
* Up to 4 players in a single match
* Dying only knocks you out for 10 seconds and you drop some gold
* Chat with people in matches
* Less health, no blocking makes the mazes even more dangerous
* Fair match-ups where unlocked equipment bonuses don't matter

Also new are Seeded Maps for singleplayer. If you find a good map layout that you like, you can play it again by entering the same seed. Or if you would like to compete with friends at who can beat a specific map the fastest, seeded maps allow you to play the same exact one.

There are plenty of minor improvements and bugfixes in this version as well.
